related.title: PostgreSQL：Read Committed 的陳述式快照
related.titleEn: PostgreSQL: statement snapshots at Read Committed
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：建立兩個帳戶並在扣款後故意拋出錯誤，證明交易未部分生效。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Create two accounts and inject an exception after debit to demonstrate all-or-nothing effects. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用兩個工作階段追蹤同一交易內兩次 SELECT 可能看見不同已提交值。
related.differenceEn: Trace how two SELECTs inside one transaction can see different committed values across sessions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 原子性把一組寫入視為一個提交單位；應用程式必須明確處理例外並 rollback。 教學基準：1000+400 = 1400 conserved balance；第二檢核：1000-150 = 850 successful A balance。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
PostgreSQL Read Committed 以每個陳述式的開始建立可見性快照，不保證交易全程重複讀取相同。 教學基準：20-3 = 17 second statement stock；第二檢核：20-17 = 3 observed change。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Atomicity makes grouped writes one commit unit; application exceptions require explicit rollback handling. Teaching baseline: 1000+400 = 1400 conserved balance; second check: 1000-150 = 850 successful A balance. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

PostgreSQL Read Committed takes a statement-start snapshot and does not promise identical repeated reads throughout a transaction. Teaching baseline: 20-3 = 17 second statement stock; second check: 20-17 = 3 observed change. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: B+ 樹：頁容量、扇出與高度模型
related.titleEn: B+ trees: page capacity,fanout and height
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：建立兩個帳戶並在扣款後故意拋出錯誤，證明交易未部分生效。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。

related.difference: 從頁大小與 entry 大小估算扇出，區分內節點與葉節點的容量。
related.differenceEn: Estimate fanout from page and entry sizes while separating internal and leaf capacities.

B+ 樹靠有序分支縮小搜尋；理想滿頁高度只提供下界，非資料庫實際 I/O 保證。 教學基準：floor((4096-96)/40) = 100 entries per page；第二檢核：ceil(10000/100) = 100 leaf pages。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
